snippet.title: Please, Spin - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The wheel of fate roguelike where you spin for your life. Customize your wheel, discover game-breaking relics, survive twisted side events, and outsmart rigged bosses to beat the lunatic host and escape the broadcast! 

Wishlist Now: https://www.store.steampowered.com/app/4067820/Please_Spin
